theorems.name: Submission.cmr_df_det_update_sum_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n) (u : Fin n → Euclid n), ∑ i : Fin n, Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => Function.update u i (A (u i)) j k) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) A * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => u j k)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
